quarterly_data.signal: 10-K backlog and commitments: backlog at December 31, 2025 was $3,027.2 million, up $125.0 million or 4.3% from $2,902.2 million a year earlier, of which approximately $1,890.0 million to $1,910.0 million was expected to convert to net revenue in 2026. Remaining performance obligations for active projects were approximately $3.6 billion (2024: $3.5 billion), about 55% expected to be recognized over the next twelve months (2024: 43%). Medpace had minimum purchase commitments for project-related supplies of $18.8 million (preferential pricing in return; expiring through 2030), and capital spending fell 49 basis points to 1.24% of revenue in 2025.
